title: glab api projects/${project}/environments?per_page=100 [--paginate]
description: The project's environments, ${project} its path URL-encoded, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh`: the first page, whose ids, names, states, and updates make a mark (forge/gitlab:marks, with forge::gitlab_marks); and every page (forge/gitlab:environments) and folds in `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::gitlab_environments), each one's page ${project's page}/-/environments/${id}. The list presents API::Entities::Environment, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/lib/api/environments.rb, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/ describes it; it holds no web_url and no branches.
